rows.selection: 2017-2018 visits to historical-map features within 100-square-kilometre regional grid units. Additional locations came from previous surveys, imagery and local informants.
rows.metric: Map-feature positives unlinked to earlier reports

rows.qualification: Imprecise earlier coordinates mean some unlinked locations may have been visited before.

rows.fieldwork_years: Remote detection published 2020; earlier Mughal survey records
rows.period_scope: Legacy archaeological records span periods; remotely proposed clusters lack field-verified period assignments
rows.selection: Multisensor classifier plus photointerpretation of visible mound-like surfaces in the Cholistan study footprint. Five training and twenty validation mounds were selected for clear location, large size and preservation. Legacy coordinates and ephemeral surface scatters limit matching.
rows.metric: Remote clusters not securely linked to legacy locations
rows.locator: Results, Remote Detection of Mound-Like Features
rows.qualification: Unmatched clusters are candidates for reconciliation and field checking.

rows.period_scope: Physical mound enumeration; not a count of independently dated Indus settlements
rows.selection: Targeted Rakhigarhi-hinterland investigation of the named Masudpur group, whose earlier gazetteer listed four mounds with one coordinate.
rows.metric: Mapped mound count divided by legacy mound count
rows.denominator_unit: legacy mounds grouped at one coordinate
rows.locator: University of Cambridge Land, Water and Settlement project, 2009 Season, Masudpur section
rows.qualification: The ratio describes enumeration under finer mapping. It does not count nine confirmed new settlements or new phases.

selection_interpretation: Green's 2018 prefilter of apparent ponds and dunes can raise the checked positive fraction relative to all mapped features. The direction of the 2017 stopping rule depends on differences between grid units. These selection effects prevent a population detection-rate interpretation.
interpretation: Each ratio answers a local question with its own unit, period scope and selection. No civilization-wide missing-site or artifact total, pooled detection probability or guaranteed frequency bound is calculated.
